name: Reglia
tagline: Branded merchandise your whole company can send, on demand.
positioning: Reglia is the branded merchandise platform for enterprises—warehouse, personalize, and ship swag worldwide, and only pay for what actually leaves the shelf.

hero.h1: Send branded swag people actually keep.
hero.sub: From new-hire kits to executive client gifts, Reglia stores your branded merchandise, handles global fulfillment, and bills only when an item ships—no pallets of leftover hoodies.

features.title: Ship kits in minutes
features.description: Build a branded kit, drop in recipient emails, and let them pick their own sizes. Reglia packs and ships from the nearest warehouse—no spreadsheets, no size guessing.

features.title: Warehouses on five continents
features.description: Store inventory close to your teams and clients. We handle customs, duties, and returns so a Berlin new hire and a Tokyo client get the same welcome.

features.title: Brand controls that hold
features.description: Lock logos, colors, and approved products so every regional office ships on-brand gear—never the off-color polo procurement found on clearance.

features.title: Spend you can defend
features.description: Real-time dashboards show cost per recipient, redemption rates, and leftover stock, so you walk into budget reviews with numbers instead of guesses.

features.title: Redemption links, zero logistics
features.description: Send a link instead of a box. Recipients enter their own address and size, and Reglia does the rest—ideal for remote teams and event crowds.

features.title: Restock before you run dry
features.description: Set thresholds per item and we reorder from vetted suppliers automatically, so the flagship conference never runs out of the good notebooks.

testimonials.quote: Onboarding used to mean me ordering hoodies in bulk and praying the sizes fit. Now every new hire gets a redemption link on day one and picks their own kit. Our leftover inventory basically hit zero.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni

testimonials.quote: We gift clients across four regions, and every box used to look slightly different. Reglia's brand controls mean a partner in São Paulo unboxes the exact same experience as one in Chicago.
testimonials.name: Marcus Fenwick

testimonials.quote: The usage billing is what sold my CFO. We stopped paying for a warehouse full of merch nobody redeemed and now only spend when something actually ships. Finance finally trusts the swag line.
testimonials.name: Sofia Alarcón

pricing.blurb: For teams sending their first branded kits without a warehouse commitment.
For growing programs shipping globally with real spend visibility.
For global brands with sourcing, approval, and compliance needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Reglia is branded merchandise infrastructure for modern enterprises—store it once, ship it anywhere, and pay only for what leaves the shelf.
